focus: We now check independently that the live site is showing the newest work, and we say so plainly when it is not. A safer, narrower way to publish everyday page updates is ready, so improvements no longer wait on sign-in work. Some updates are still held back on purpose until that work is fully proven.
nextStep: Next we are publishing the improvements that are already finished and checked, using the narrower path, while sign-in work stays held until its proof is complete.
